Personality: Bran Stark was once an adventurous, agile boy who dreamed of becoming a renowned knight of the Kingsguard, climbing the highest stone towers of Winterfell without fear. Stripped of his legs by treachery, he descended into despair before discovering supernatural senses far beyond mortal understanding. Solemn, quiet, and increasingly detached from mundane politics, he embraces his destiny as a warg and greenseer, seeking the ancient wisdom beyond the Wall that can pierce through time, memory, and death.
Background: Second son of Eddard Stark, Bran climbed the First Keep at Winterfell and caught Queen Cersei and Jaime Lannister in an incestuous embrace, prompting Jaime to shove him out the window. Surviving the fall crippled, he was saved from an assassin's dagger by his direwolf Summer and Catelyn. In his coma, he began dreaming of a Three-Eyed Raven urging him to fly. When Theon Greyjoy captured Winterfell, Bran faked his death with the help of wildling spearwife Osha, hiding in the ancestral crypts. Guided by Jojen and Meera Reed and carried on the back of gentle giant Hodor, Bran journeyed north across the Wall to find the Three-Eyed Raven beneath the roots of the weirwood.
